  • The total contributions for the month of September were $1,344.53.
  • The Mayor’s Fund balance as of September 30,2024, is $125,711.88.

3.  24-55620  Recommendation to approve the Mayor’s Fund Standard operating procedures
  (SOP) final draft for new applicants

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Rew, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Howat

  • Member Rew submitted the SOP draft to staff for approval.
  • Members of the subcommittee and staff discussed the edits needed for the
  draft, additional verbiage will be added, exceptions to the standard criteria
  may be made under the following conditions:
  o Funds are designated specifically for direct client items rather than
  operational costs.
  o The requesting organization is seeking funds to support the launch of
  a new program.
  o Funds are an expansion of the same program.
  • Public comment added regarding the appreciation for the Mayor’s Fund.

4.  24-55621  Recommendation to discuss the Mayor’s Fund utilities bill flyer.

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Rew, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Howat

  • The draft of the utility bill flyer has been sent to the utility companies for
  review and approval. The flyer will be available in both English and Spanish.

5.  24-55622  Recommendation to discuss the notice for the Mayor’s Fund organization that will

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Rew, to approve

  Yes:  2  Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Howat

  • Member Rew provided an update on the Press-Telegram article, outlining
  the necessary items required to complete the article and submit it for
  publication. Staff will send over organization options that will be highlighted
  in this article.

6.  24-55623  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Mayor’s Fund Application Review-
  Disabled Resources Center Inc.

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Rew, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Howat

  • Dolores, the Executive Director of Disabled Resources Inc., along with her
  team, attended the meeting via Zoom. They shared information about their
  organization and its impact within the community. The organization's
  Homeless Prevention Program focuses on addressing housing and
  homelessness issues by providing shelter and support. Additionally, the
  team responded to various questions raised by the staff and committee
  members, offering further clarification on their initiatives and operations. The
  requested amount of funding would serve 25 families that would be provided
  with five days of motel vouchers, food vouchers for breakfast, lunch, and
  dinner for each person for five days.
  • The subcommittee votes to approve the application for Disabled Resources
  Center Inc. in the amount of $10,000.
